<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html,
    body {
      height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #f8fafc, #cbd5e1);
      color: #0f172a;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    svg {
      width: min(400px, 90vw);
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 24px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35));
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      body {
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #1e293b, #020617);
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
      svg {
        animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      @keyframes float {
        0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
        50%      { transform: translateY(-12px); }
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
    <title id="circle-title">A dark circle with a soft highlight</title>
    <defs>
      <radialGradient id="sphere" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="75%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#64748b"/>
        <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#1e293b"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#020617"/>
      </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="196" fill="url(#sphere)"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
Updated `0.html` with these improvements:

- **Layout fix**: replaced the 100vw/100vh flex body with a grid using `100dvh`, which removes the horizontal scrollbar and handles mobile browser chrome correctly.
- **Responsive SVG**: width is now `min(400px, 90vw)` so the circle shrinks on small screens instead of overflowing.
- **Accessibility**: added `role="img"` and a `<title>` so screen readers describe the graphic. Title tag changed from a hash to "Circle".
- **Visual polish**: the circle now uses a radial gradient for a sphere-like look, with a drop shadow and a soft page background. Dark mode is supported via `prefers-color-scheme`.
- **Subtle motion**: a gentle float animation, disabled automatically for users who prefer reduced motion.

The SVG `id` was kept unchanged in case anything references it.

- **Accessibility**: added `role="img"` and a `<title>` so screen readers describe the graphic. Title tag changed from a hash to "Circle".
- **Visual polish**: the circle now uses a radial gradient for a sphere-like look, with a drop shadow and a soft page background. Dark mode is supported via `prefers-color-scheme`.
- **Subtle motion**: a gentle float animation, disabled automatically for users who prefer reduced motion.

The SVG `id` was kept unchanged in case anything references it.
